study_design: Phase III double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled prevention trial of selenium among men with high-grade prostatic intraepithelial neoplasia.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Of 619 enrolled patients, 423 randomized men with HGPIN (212 selenium and 211 placebo) were eligible (by central pathology review) and included in the primary analysis.
reason: The trial prospectively assessed progression from HGPIN to incident prostate cancer. Although Gleason scores of diagnosed cancers were compared between arms, the abstract does not establish an analysis of high-grade prostate cancer incidence using the initially at-risk trial population as the denominator.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The primary endpoint was progression of HGPIN to prostate cancer over a 3-year period.
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported trial endpoint is incident prostate cancer overall, not an aggressive prostate cancer incidence endpoint.
